Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

The room is filled with officials, reporters, and cameras. A large banner reads "WORLD RECORD HOLDER" in bold letters. At the center of the room, a frail but determined 127-year-old man, GEORGE, stands proudly, his eyes shining with tears.

GEORGE
(whispering to himself)
I Did It. I Really Did It.

The officials approach George, presenting him with a certificate and a gold medal.

OFFICIAL
Mr. George, Congratulations! You have been officially recognized as the Oldest Human to Ever Live.

GEORGE
(smiling)
Thank You. Thank You So Much.

The room erupts in applause as George is mobbed by reporters and well-wishers.

CUT TO:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

George lies in bed, his eyes fixed on the ceiling. He takes a deep breath, and his mind begins to wander back to his youth.

GEORGE
(whispering to himself)
Quantum Immortality... I Remember Reading About It Online...

As he recalls the theory, George's expression changes from calm to confused. He starts to feel a sense of unease, like a weight is pressing down on him.

GEORGE
(whispering)
If I'm Immortal... If I'm Trapped in a Quantum Loop... What Does That Mean?

George's eyes widen as the implications sink in. He starts to feel a sense of panic, his breathing quickening.

GEORGE
(whispering)
I'm Not Really Alive... I'm Just a Simulation... A Never-Ending Loop of Birth and Death...

George's body begins to shake, his eyes rolling back in his head. He starts to mutter incoherently, his voice rising to a fever pitch.

GEORGE
(screaming)
I'M TRAPPED! I'M TRAPPED IN THIS NEVER-ENDING LOOP! I'LL NEVER BE FREE!

The camera zooms in on George's face, his eyes bulging with terror. The room around him begins to distort and blur, like a reflection in rippling water.

GEORGE
(screaming)
I'M THE OLDEST MAN ALIVE... BUT I'M NOT ALIVE AT ALL!

The camera spins wildly, capturing the chaos of George's mental breakdown. The sound design becomes increasingly distorted, like a record player skipping tracks.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - LATER

George lies in bed, his eyes closed, his body still shaking with fear. The room is quiet, except for the sound of his labored breathing.

GEORGE
(whispering)
I'm Sorry... I'm So Sorry...

The camera lingers on George's face, his expression a mix of terror and despair. The screen fades to black, leaving the audience wondering what will happen next.

FADE TO BLACK.
